Implement three experimental arms: (A) LLM-only single-shot generation with verifier pass/fail logging; (B) verify-then-abort: single generation + verifier + human-like abort metric simulated; (C) full GVR: LLM generates, deterministic verifier (Batfish-compatible or equivalent open verifier) produces counterexamples, LLM is prompted with counterexample and repair instructions iteratively until verifier passes or a bounded iteration/model-call budget is reached. Use two LLM endpoints (public APIs) representing contemporary high-capability models. Freeze prompts, seeds, verifier versions, budget caps, and retry policy in a preregistration JSON before execution. Record all model calls, verifier outputs, repair iterations, and produced configurations.","expected_data":"Per-task: final verifier pass/fail, number of repair iterations, total model-call counts, model tokens per call, instances of semantic regression during repairs, counterexample traces, and end-to-end pipeline latency. Present cost-effectiveness frontiers and compute gains from adaptive expose baseline semantic-failure rates for contemporary LLMs and enable reproducible evaluation of GVR-style defenses?","hypotheses":["A curated benchmark combining intent tasks, topologies, and verifier harnesses will expose nonzero, task-dependent semantic-failure rates across contemporary LLMs, enabling meaningful baseline comparisons.","Including verifier-based metrics and counterexample traces will enable reproducible measurement of repair-method efficacy (GVR) across models and pipelines.","A released artifact bundle with frozen prompts, containerized verifier, baseline pipelines, and hashes will achieve reproducible baseline matches across controlled reruns for a held-out subset of tasks.",""],"proposed_design":"Design 200 tasks covering ACLs, reachability, inter-AS routing invariants, and mixed-policy scenarios. Provide an open verifier harness (Batfish-compatible or equivalent in a container), canonical prompts, two baseline pipelines (LLM-only and GVR), CI-ready scripts, and a reproducibility README. Run baseline experiments with two public LLM APIs and publish per-task baseline results, artifact hashes, and a reproducibility manifest. Freeze all artifacts, seeds, and versions before release.","expected_data":"Released dataset artifacts (200 tasks), per-task baseline results for two LLMs and two pipeline variants (verifier pass/fail, repair iterations, model-call accounting), reproducibility manifest with hashes, and CI scripts that reproduce a held-out-subset run producing matching artifact hashes.","primary_outcome":"Public availability of NetOps-GVR-Bench with baseline results demonstrating measurable semantic-failure rates and a reproducibility manifest showing rerun matches for held-out tasks.","analysis_outline":"Report descriptive statistics of baseline semantic-failure rates overall and by task class; quantify inter-model variability using intraclass correlation and paired comparisons; demonstrate reproducibility by rerunning a held-out subset and reporting artifact-hash matches and a reproducibility score (proportion of matches). Provide baseline scripts and guidance for future comparisons.","novelty_evidence_ids":["https://openalex.org/W4399629579","https://openalex.org/W4403635865","doi:10.36227/techrxiv.175021940.06537275/v1"],"feasibility_evidence_ids":["https://openalex.org/W4396723768","doi:10.1002/nem.2313","https://openalex.org/W4402670687"],"risks":["Licensing constraints on real-world configuration data (mitigation: use license-permitted sources and synthetic augmentation).","Benchmark overfitting by early adopters (mitigation: include withheld holdout tasks and encourage blinded evaluations).","Maintenance burden and dependency on external verifier versions (mitigation: containerized verifier harness and versioned artifacts).","Potential community misuse of benchmark artifacts (mitigation: acceptable-use terms and ethical guidance)."],"estimated_model_calls":3000}]} for TypeAdapter(CandidateSet); 3 validation errors for CandidateSet
